gripOrHq.title: Scorched Earth
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 4 meat damage.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: Hunting Pack
gripOrHq.rulesText: For each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Hunting Pack, Hunting Pack has one subroutine as follows: "*Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag."

gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Reclamation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

gripOrHq.title: Hostile Takeover
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

heapOrArchives.title: Dedicated Response Team
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dedicated Response Team, it does 3 meat damage. Ignore this effect unless Runner is tagged.

heapOrArchives.title: Cybertech Think Tank
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Cybertech Think Tank before and after you rez it. Cybertech Think Tank advancement counter: Increase by 1 the meat damage dealt by another source.

discardCards.title: Corolla Speed Chip
discardCards.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Corolla Speed Chip when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using killers during runs. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

discardCards.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

ice.title: Hunting Pack
ice.rulesText: For each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Hunting Pack, Hunting Pack has one subroutine as follows: "*Trace 5-If trace is successful, give Runner a tag."

root.title: Paris City Grid
root.rulesText: Put [3] from the bank on Paris City Grid when you rez it. Use these bits only to pay for traces made during runs on this fort. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

root.title: Dr. Dreff
root.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Fetch 4.0.1
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Asp
ice.rulesText: *Trace 5-If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [1].

root.title: Dedicated Response Team
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Dedicated Response Team, it does 3 meat damage. Ignore this effect unless Runner is tagged.

root.title: Cybertech Think Tank
root.rulesText: You may advance Cybertech Think Tank before and after you rez it. Cybertech Think Tank advancement counter: Increase by 1 the meat damage dealt by another source.

ice.title: Data Raven
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag and a Data Raven counter. Each Data Raven counter gives Runner a tag at the start of each Runner turn. Runner may remove a Data Raven counter by taking an action to pay [1].

ice.title: Jack Attack
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner cannot jack out.
[Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.
